title: My White Kite
lines: Mike runs in the sun with a white kite.
A big puff lifts the kite up and up.
Then it lands in a tall pine.
"My kite!" said Mike. "I can not get it."
Mike jumps up at it, but he slips.
Jill stops next to him on a red bike.
"Look! A long stick in the grass," said Jill.
He stands on a rock and taps the kite.
The white kite drops off. Mike grabs it.
"Thank you, Jill!" said Mike with a smile.

questions.listenFor: In a tall pine. If they say "a tree," that counts, but ask which line told them.

questions.ask: Jumping up at the kite does not work. What does Mike do that does?
questions.listenFor: He gets the long stick Jill spots, stands on a rock and taps the kite. Lines seven and eight.

questions.ask: Have you ever had something stuck up high? How did you get it down?
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Mike used a long stick and stood on a rock, in lines seven and eight.
